purpose: Descriptive fixed-model, first-ten sensitivity; no repair selection or causal claim

views.gap_plus_0_1_ms: add 0.1ms to each of the nine inter-arrival gaps, clip to the schema maximum; first gap remains zero
views.gap_minus_0_1_ms: subtract 0.1ms from each of the nine inter-arrival gaps, clip at zero; first gap remains zero
views.first_opposite_direction_swap_within_1_m: swap direction-and-size metadata of the first adjacent opposite-direction pair among indices1..9 separated by at most1ms, keeping timestamp slots; no swap when no such pair exists

rules: Each view applies to first10 only, including the swap; there are no future packets, domains or IP/process inputs. Compare unchanged model probabilities/top choice with each view and report counts by class, including unchanged no-swap cases. No fitted weights, threshold selection, data augmentation, extra seeds, scoring public final/calibration or operational accuracy claim.
limits: Abstract stress tests, not protocol-preserving network simulation or a faithful Chrome/on-wire reconstruction. Per-gap changes can alter total prefix duration by up to0.9ms. A swap moves each selected metadata record to the other time slot by at most1ms. These are reused exposed development connections on limited networks, not independent visits, out-of-distribution calibration or final accuracy. The final-test and calibration recordings remain entirely excluded. No candidate or default promotion.
